inputs.methodJa: 固定WEBの各提案節本文を読み、必要な前後節も同じ固定ファイルで照合。別名の明示と出現時点を判定。地理資料・現代座標の独立検証は本レビュー範囲外。

aliasReviews.sourceText: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

basisJa.placeIdentity: 本文が同一の都市を旧名/改名後の名で明示している。別の地名・部族名との混同ではない。
basisJa.temporalGate: この旧名と都市の同一性はこのknownBy節で初めて明示されるため、ここより前へ統合同一性を遡及させない。

aliasReviews.qualificationJa: この判定は固定WEBの本文上の地名同一性に限る。現代遺跡の同定や座標の検証を意味しない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: 旧名LuzはBethelの旧名として示される。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: 別の人物がヒッタイト人の地へ行き、別個の都市を建ててLuzと名付ける。Bethel aliasとは統合しない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: Laishの都市名をDanへ改めたと明示。父祖Dan/部族Danitesとは別の場所IDを保つ。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: Danitesはtribe/peopleであり、Danの都市IDへ取り込まない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.
When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: 直前のJebusを指すため、都市の文脈を補強する。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: Jerusalemの住民Jebusitesが登場するが、Jebusitesは人々でありJebus/Jerusalem場所の別名ではない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: Aijalonはヨセフ家が支配を強めた地域の列挙中に現れる。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: 別の文脈でゼブルンの地のAijalonに葬られたと明記。二つの用例を名前一致だけで同一地点に統合しない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: Danitesの相続地がまだ決まっていないという部族の土地文脈。Dan市の改名記事（18:29）とは異なる型であり、同一地点扱いしない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: Lehiはペリシテ人が陣営を張った場所として出る。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire; and his bands dropped from off his hands.
When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: 顎骨を投げた場所がRamath Lehiと呼ばれたという命名。Lehi全域と同一地点とは断定しない。

distinctnessChecks.sourceText: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.
distinctnessChecks.findingJa: 水の出たくぼみの名をEn Hakkoreとし、それがLehiの中にあると明記。包含関係であり同一地点の別名とは扱わない。

limitationsJa: 本文に明示された地名同一性は支持するが、地名IDの統合実行や現代遺跡の同定、座標の正当化はこの報告では承認しない。本文で別の新都市として記されるJDG 1:26のLuz、Dan地域/部族、Jebusites集団、Lehi周辺名は別扱い。
